description: Langevin models (-) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by U Oldenburg; U Münster. Model wind velocities, wind power feed-in, and other turbulence-driven dynamic systems. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: arbitrary. Software: GNU R. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-2+. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
